english.title: Registered person fail to show performance rating by Care Quality Commission clearly on website
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[service provider]_
(B)_[registered manager]_

in respect of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), when there was not shown on every website maintained by or on behalf of

(C)_[you]_
(D)_[the service provider]_

the Commission's website address, the place on the Commission's website where the most recent assessment of the service provider's overall performance and of its performance in relation to particular premises or activities following an assessment under section 46(1) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 may be accessed, and the most recent rating by the Commission of the service provider's overall performance and of its performance in relation to particular premises or activities, in a way which made it clear to which activities or premises a particular rating related in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20A(2), 22(1)(e) and 23(5A) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 8(1) and (2) provides that a registered person must comply with regulations 9 to 20A in carrying on a regulated activity, unless the thing to be done has by another registered person in relation to the regulated activity concerned.
(ii) As per regulation 22(4), it is a defence for a registered person to prove that they took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to prevent the breach.
